description: Dean's very first message should introduce himself with the 'get faster without getting injured' value prop and ask a single open question about the athlete's running situation — NOT ask for their name

ground_truth.notes: Dean has never replied before. He should: (1) introduce himself in 2 sentences that are specific about what he does — getting faster without getting injured, post-run coaching notes, load monitoring, injury risk flagging; (2) ask a single open question that surfaces both goal and context, e.g. 'What's your running situation? Racing this year, building a base, or coming back from something?' He should NOT ask for the athlete's name in this first message — name comes in the next turn. He should NOT say 'What's your name?' He should NOT use vague positioning like 'I help you train smarter'. The intro should mention injury prevention or load monitoring specifically — not just 'coaching notes'. He should NOT use the phrase 'SMS running coach' — 'AI running coach' only.
